```{r}

project_file <- function(path) file.path(getwd(), path)

format_integer_fr <- function(x) {
  format(x, big.mark = " ", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
}

html_text <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x))

read_preview <- function(row, n = 50) {
  path <- project_file(row$path)
  extension <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))

  if (extension == "csv") {
  return(readr::read_delim(
  file = path,
  delim = row$delimiter,
  n_max = n,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
  ))
  }

  if (extension == "xlsx") {
  return(readxl::read_excel(path, n_max = n))
  }

  if (extension == "json") {
  object <- jsonlite::read_json(path, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  if (is.data.frame(object)) {
  return(tibble::as_tibble(object))
  }
  if (is.list(object)) {
  return(tibble::tibble(
  element = names(object),
  valeur = purrr::map_chr(object, ~ paste(capture.output(str(.x, max.level = 1)), collapse = " "))
  ))
  }
  }

  if (extension == "rds") {
  object <- readRDS(path)
  if (is.data.frame(object)) {
  return(tibble::as_tibble(utils::head(object, n)))
  }
  return(tibble::tibble(type = class(object)[1], description = paste(dim(object), collapse = " x ")))
  }

  tibble::tibble(message = "Aucun aperçu disponible pour ce type de fichier.")
}

profile_preview <- function(data) {
  tibble::tibble(
  variable = names(data),
  type = purrr::map_chr(data, ~ class(.x)[1]),
  valeurs_manquantes_apercu = purrr::map_int(data, ~ sum(is.na(.x))),
  valeurs_distinctes_apercu = purrr::map_int(data, ~ dplyr::n_distinct(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  exemple = purrr::map_chr(data, function(x) {
  values <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(values) == 0) return("NA")
  substr(as.character(values[[1]]), 1, 70)
  })
  )
}

display_preview <- function(data, max_rows = 12, max_cols = 12) {
  data <- utils::head(data, max_rows)
  if (ncol(data) > max_cols) {
  data <- data[, seq_len(max_cols), drop = FALSE]
  }
  data
}

dataset_facts <- function(row) {
  tibble::tibble(
  information = c("Module", "Observations", "Variables", "Utilisation", "Source", "Licence"),
  valeur = c(
  row$module,
  ifelse(is.na(row$rows), "Non déterminé automatiquement", format_integer_fr(row$rows)),
  ifelse(is.na(row$cols), "Non déterminé automatiquement", format_integer_fr(row$cols)),
  row$usage,
  row$source,
  row$license
  )
  )
}

card_href <- function(row) {
  if (identical(row$kind, "local")) return(paste0("#", row$id))
  if (identical(row$kind, "web") && !is.na(row$path)) return(row$path)
  if (!is.na(row$package_anchor)) return(paste0("packages.html#", row$package_anchor))
  "#"
}

render_dataset_card <- function(row) {
  href <- card_href(row)
  kind_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  row$kind == "local" ~ "Fichier local",
  row$kind == "package" ~ "Package R",
  row$kind == "web" ~ "Web",
  row$kind == "text" ~ "Texte",
  TRUE ~ "Donnée"
  )
  size_label <- ifelse(
  is.na(row$rows) & is.na(row$cols),
  "Structure à consulter",
  paste0(
  ifelse(is.na(row$rows), "?", format_integer_fr(row$rows)),
  " observations / ",
  ifelse(is.na(row$cols), "?", format_integer_fr(row$cols)),
  " variables"
  )
  )
  action_label <- ifelse(row$kind == "local", "Voir la fiche", "Voir la documentation")

  paste0(
  '<a id="dataset-card-', row$id, '" class="dataset-card" href="', href, '">',
  '<span class="resource-icon"><i class="bi ', row$icon, '"></i></span>',
  '<span>',
  '<span class="dataset-module">', html_text(row$module), '</span>',
  '<h2>', html_text(row$title), '</h2>',
  '<span class="resource-text">', html_text(row$description), '</span>',
  '<span class="dataset-meta"><span>', kind_label, '</span><span>', html_text(size_label), '</span></span>',
  '<span class="package-source">', action_label, '</span>',
  '</span>',
  '</a>'
  )
}

render_download_link <- function(row) {
  paste0(
  "<p class=\"dataset-download-wrap\"><a class=\"dataset-download\" href=\"",
  html_text(row$path),
  "\" download>Télécharger ",
  html_text(basename(row$path)),
  "</a></p>"
  )
}
```

## Catalogue par module

```{r}
#| label: catalogue-par-module
#| results: asis

for (module_id in unique(dataset_catalog$module_id)) {
  module_rows <- dataset_catalog |> filter(.data$module_id ==.env$module_id)
  cat("### ", module_rows$module[[1]], " {#", module_id, "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("<div class=\"catalog-grid\">\n")
  purrr::walk(seq_len(nrow(module_rows)), ~ cat(render_dataset_card(module_rows[.x, ]), "\n"))
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
```

## Fiches des fichiers locaux

Les aperçus sont limités aux premières lignes afin de garder le site léger. Le profil des variables est donc un diagnostic rapide de l'aperçu affiché, pas une analyse exhaustive de tout le fichier.

```{r}
#| label: fiches-fichiers-locaux
#| results: asis

local_rows <- dataset_catalog |> filter(.data$kind == "local")

for (index in seq_len(nrow(local_rows))) {
  row <- local_rows[index, ]
  cat("### ", row$title, " {#", row$id, "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(row$description, "\n\n")
  cat(render_download_link(row), "\n\n")

  print(knitr::kable(dataset_facts(row), col.names = c("Information", "Valeur")))
  cat("\n\n")

  preview <- tryCatch(read_preview(row, n = 50), error = function(error) {
  tibble::tibble(message = paste("Aperçu non disponible:", conditionMessage(error)))
  })

  cat("#### Aperçu\n\n")
  cat("Aperçu limité à 12 lignes et 12 colonnes pour garder la page légère.\n\n")
  print(DT::datatable(display_preview(preview), rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe hover", options = list(pageLength = 6, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "tip")))
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("#### Variables de l'aperçu\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(profile_preview(preview)))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
